import os,json,System,clr
clr.AddReference('Grasshopper')
import Grasshopper as GH
root='C:\\Users\\08432.SINOLTD\\00.DEVE\\31.AEC\\RHINO_Deve\\EnvironmentalSimulationHub'
components=[]
for proxy in GH.Instances.ComponentServer.ObjectProxies:
 if str(proxy.Desc.Category)!='Eddy3D':continue
 name=str(proxy.Desc.Name)
 if not any(t in name.lower() for t in ['case','domain','wind','probe','simulation','boundary','mesh']):continue
 obj=GH.Instances.ComponentServer.EmitObject(proxy.Guid)
 if obj is None or not isinstance(obj,GH.Kernel.IGH_Component):continue
 def params(collection):
  return [{'name':str(p.Name),'nickname':str(p.NickName),'description':str(p.Description),'type':str(p.GetType().FullName),'optional':p.Optional} for p in collection]
 components.append({'name':name,'guid':str(proxy.Guid),'description':str(obj.Description),'assembly':obj.GetType().Assembly.Location,'type':str(obj.GetType().FullName),'inputs':params(obj.Params.Input),'outputs':params(obj.Params.Output)})
assemblies=[]
for a in System.AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies():
 try:location=a.Location
 except Exception:continue
 if 'eddy3d' not in location.lower():continue
 assemblies.append({'name':str(a.GetName().Name),'version':str(a.GetName().Version),'path':location})
package='C:/Users/08432.SINOLTD/AppData/Roaming/McNeel/Rhinoceros/packages/8.0/Eddy3D/1.15.0-beta.827'
workflow_files=[];solver_files=[]
for folder,dirs,files in os.walk(package):
 for name in files:
  if name.lower().endswith(('.gh','.ghx')):workflow_files.append(os.path.join(folder,name))
  if name.lower().endswith('.exe'):solver_files.append(os.path.join(folder,name))
report={'package':package,'assemblies':assemblies,'components':components,'packaged_workflows':workflow_files,'packaged_executables':solver_files,'solver_execution':'NOT RUN','openfoam':'UNVERIFIED','scope':'Read-only runtime metadata; instantiated components were not added to a document or solved.'}
json.dump(report,open(os.path.join(root,'docs','evidence','wind_api_audit.json'),'w',encoding='utf-8'),indent=2)
print(json.dumps({'components':len(components),'assemblies':len(assemblies),'packaged_workflows':len(workflow_files),'packaged_executables':len(solver_files)}))
